name: @mercatus-liber/accounting-sync
description: Pushes a paid order into a real accounting/ERP system of record (epic accounting-erp-sync-adapter, traced to .pHive/planning/epic-backlog.md row 77's ica-02 gap finding: no adapter/interface anywhere pushed a completed order into a merchant's real accounting system). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only; reads order data via a narrow structural interface (OrderLookup), never importing @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders directly, mirroring @mercatus-liber/fulfillment/@mercatus-liber/inventory's own narrow-dependency discipline exactly. Owns the AccountingSyncAdapter contract every real provider adapter implements (see @mercatus-liber/adapter-quickbooks) and registerAccountingSync, which fires a sync on the real checkout.order.paid event -- fire-and-forget, never blocking checkout (see src/subscriber.ts's own doc comment for why).
